title: Main stream real stories: drop HF registry, force authoring
summary: Grounded in the real scheduled run, which ended blocked/restart and whose main stream was 100% Hugging Face model-registry entries with templated why_it_matters and a duplicated summary, while the final review passed with zero authoring tasks. Three fixes so the main stream becomes real, agent-authored stories: (1) reject huggingface_trending candidates from the main story stream in mainRejectReason so model-registry popularity signals stay only in their own section and stop filling main; (2) broaden the main-refill operational-signal matcher to admit consumer, business and content-AI news (funding, acquisition, revenue, short-form video, image/video generation, creator economy) so real news can fill main instead of registry noise; (3) extend the review template detector to the deterministic reader-impact boilerplate signature (价值集中在 / 信号集中在) so templated story why_it_matters is routed to the editorial loop for the coding agent to rewrite, instead of passing review untouched. On budget exhaustion the existing degrade-with-disclosure path still publishes. IA unchanged this round (reference sources like X/WeChat/Jike/podcasts are not capturable without new ingestion).

lessons.lesson: Section-lane candidates can double-dip into the main stream if main evaluation does not exclude them by category.
lessons.evidence: Hugging Face trending model-registry candidates carry category huggingface_trending and are selected into their section, but the main evaluator re-scored all candidates and they filled every main slot; rejecting that category from main fixed it and let real news rise.
lessons.recommended_action: Exclude dedicated-lane categories from main eligibility, and verify the main stream against a real run rather than the self-test.

lessons.lesson: The review gate's template detection was a phrase list that missed the dominant boilerplate, so a fully templated report passed with zero authoring tasks.
lessons.evidence: The scheduled run's stories all shared the reader-impact boilerplate (价值集中在 / 信号集中在), which was not in the detector; review returned ok with no tasks. Binding the detector to that generator signature forces the authoring loop.
lessons.recommended_action: Bind template detection to the deterministic generator's output signature, not to ad-hoc phrases, so new template families cannot slip through.

followups.action: Fix no_signal source parsers (Anthropic and big-tech org feeds), add missing sources, and self-host an RSSHub instance to ingest Zhihu and WeChat; only then consider aligning the section IA to the reference daily.
